steps: At a reviewed release-generation step, fetch the exact official source URL for each required taxonomy and record retrieval date, source revision/date, response SHA-256, and licence review outcome.

For country labels/codes, use the current ISO Maintenance Agency/OBP or official collection; emit only the explicitly approved country subset and never infer a country from device, IP, provider, or phone.
For education levels and fields, read the current UIS classification release and emit stable code identifiers only after legal review; do not copy manual prose or third-party components.
For India, consult the current UGC degree-notification index for research only; keep degree_name and specialization as exact user-entered values rather than generating an exhaustive degree list.
Run the contract tests before any source artifact is promoted. A missing or stale source must fail generation/release review, not trigger an end-user network fetch.
